Angry Birds Trilogy.name: Angry Birds Trilogy
Angry Birds Trilogy.summary:
The game contains the first three games of the popular mobile game series.
Both the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 versions of the game are able to be played with motion controls along with the traditional controllers.

The game includes exclusive levels that cannot be found on the original games. The game also contains biographies of each bird, except for Hal (green bird), Bubbles (orange bird), and Stella (pink bird). In order for the game to update, Rovio released DLC packs: the Anger Management Pack and the Fowl Temper Pack.

Gyakuten Saiban 5.name: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney - Dual Destinies
Gyakuten Saiban 5.summary: Dual Destinies continues the style of gameplay from previous installments, in which the player must utilize evidence and find contradictions in witness statements to prove their client innocent. Like previous installments, gameplay is split up between Investigations, in which players find evidence and question witnesses, and Trials, where they must use the evidence to expose contradictions. The game now features full 3D graphics and character models, allowing more dynamic camera angles during gameplay, such as quickly panning around the courtroom in the moments before a dramatic reveal. The 3D camera also allows investigation sequences to take place in 3D spaces, permitting greater investigative depth, such as being able to rotate around a room to look for clues.
